messages:
Lina (PM): Heads-up: Cobalt wants private pilot with HSM + p95 SLA. They need staging by EoQ.
Diego (Runtime): HSM + p95 in private infra is doable but needs KV caching, quant tuning, and a fallback plan.
Priya (Infra): We have one spare prewarm slot but it's tagged for Beacon. We can reassign if Beacon agrees to delayed prewarm.
Lina (PM): Cobalt will accept a staged canary: 10% for 48h -> 40% for 72h -> 100% if metrics look good.
Marta (Security): HSM/KMS integration requires attestation + light pen test. Timeline: ~10 business days attestation/config, ~4 days pen test after infra is live. Need key policy signed pre-prod.
Diego (Runtime): Runtime action items: (1) HSM plugin config for private control plane, (2) enable KV prefix cache early, (3) quantization smoke tests and fallback routing. I can deliver playbook + fallback in 2 sprints if infra slot confirmed.
Priya (Infra): If we transfer the slot, infra (VPC peering, NAT, routes) can be ready in ~6 days. I'll need final region and slot transfer confirmation by EOD Tue.
Lina (PM): I'll talk to Beacon PM. Proposed gating for canary: a) attestation complete, b) pen test no critical findings, c) canary metrics: error_rate <0.5% and p95 within SLA for 48h.
Diego (Runtime): Add tracing, token-level telemetry, and a small prompt set for quality regression checks. Canary routing snippet I plan to use:
```yaml
canary:
  - percent: 10
    duration: 48h
  - percent: 40
    duration: 72h
rollback_on:
  - error_rate_pct: 0.5
  - p95_latency_delta_pct: 12
```
Priya (Infra): Noted. Network checklist will include HSM endpoints, KMS peering, NAT sizing, and egress rules.
Marta (Security): Ping me when infra is live and I'll schedule attestation and pen test windows.
ops-bot: Reminder: create ticket "Cobalt private pilot" in the launch-lane board: /boards/launch-lane/Cobalt-private-pilot.
Lina (PM): Action items: (1) Lina -> negotiate Beacon slot transfer by EOD Tue; (2) Priya -> prep infra template after confirmation; (3) Diego -> draft rollout playbook and telemetry hooks by next Wed; (4) Marta -> book attestation & pen test. I'll flag this as customer-driven high priority on the initiative board.
Diego (Runtime): One more runtime note: enable KV prefix caching and early aggregation to reduce p95 variance during the canary.
Lina (PM): Thanks team — Ill post follow-up and link Beacon thread. :thumbsup:
